rejected_c3.decision: numeric gate failed; preserve all complete original observations and never rerun this source to select a faster sample

substantive_change: Fetch light candidate-to-directory metadata once through the existing covering index, then batch unique chapter/session directory pairs inside the same read snapshot.
Validate all referenced directory rows and title types; malformed/orphaned/custom row/text factories retain the original full metadata path and its errors.

For eligible default lexical book recall only, compute the original finite nonnegative base relevance for every candidate. Real title boost is bounded by base and base*1.15. Retain every candidate whose upper bound is greater than or equal to the K-th base score; skip only strict lower upper bounds.

K exactly follows the existing novelty/current-query predicate: min(candidate_count, limit*4) when that pool is required, otherwise min(candidate_count, limit). Historical-query exclusion and all tie rules remain unchanged.
Expand full directory metadata and calculate final title scores only for retained candidates; preserve the original full candidate_count and truncated semantics.
Semantic, coverage, non-book, custom factory, nonfinite/negative-score or uncertified structure cases retain the unpruned original path. No persistent feature cache or query-result cache is added.
invariants: Unchanged route SQL limits/global BM25, lexical normalization, fusion arithmetic, scopes, source text/addresses, final score expressions and top-K tie order.
Unchanged source corruption checks, source snapshots, exact character/token budgets, MCP payload/envelope, result-cache behavior, schema version and dependency requirements.
Exact complete non-timing payload equivalence against published v0.3.2, including candidate_count and truncated, across retained regression configurations.

development_protocol.diagnostic_role: C3 profiles and mathematical-bound simulation guide implementation; they are not accepted timing results.
requirements: Prove pruning and every downstream candidates use, including current/historical, limit=1, ties and zero/invalid bases.
Meaningful fixtures for late score boosts, fused routes, directory duplication, scopes, malformed/orphan metadata, custom row factories, source corruption and semantic/coverage fallback.

Save a fixed native paired development comparison of the substantive C4 source against v0.3.2, retaining all selected calls and adverse cells; no repeated same-source selection for a favorable sample.
Verify full historical Hotpot256 default payload compatibility for the final C4 source before release.

formal_protocol.evaluator: A separately named C4 runner/workflow may adapt only source/provenance/path/claim registration from the frozen C3 runner; retain measurement arithmetic, datasets, configurations, order, equality rules and all numerical gates. Preserve original C3 files.
formal_protocol.binding: Commit final materially changed C4 source, evaluator and tests, then create and commit a new C4 binding before its sole exclusive formal execution.
formal_protocol.decision: All correctness and numerical gates must pass; any resource trigger needs explicit independent review. C3 gains never substitute for a missing C4 gate.

release: No v0.3.3 runtime approval, main advance or release branch until final acceptance and exact-source nine-job CI.
